correctness.rationale: The source-verified simplicial-poset cell basis has multidegree A and degree |A|+|word|. The Lü--Panov Hochster theorem and Björner--Wachs injective-word shellability put the only support cohomology in degree 2|A|. For an A-stabilizing permutation, fixed cells have pointwise-fixed word letters, with orientation sign of the circle coordinates equal to sign(g|A); fixed-word counts are falling factorials. The equivariant Euler trace yields the exact formula and sign-twisted induced module. Fixed-ordered-tuple stabilizer pairing cancels every sign-isotypic component, and rational finite-group transfer proves orbit-space vanishing. Programmatic enumeration confirmed 4166 traces for n=2..6, 15 invariant vanishings, and the n=2 sign test. Limits: no integral quotient or equivariant homotopy claim.

value.rationale: The complete symmetry character is a natural topological invariant not recoverable from a wedge count. It detects an essential circle-cell orientation twist. The resulting uniform rational acyclicity of finite orbit spaces is a striking global outcome for a family with many positive original Betti numbers, motivated by the canonical relabeling action and valid in all n. These are exact structural classifications, not an arbitrary finite statistic or a routine rank restatement.
